description: May 20 birthday meaning: Taurus or Gemini cusp, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, May 20 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Taurus or Gemini. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a May 20 birthday
paragraphs: Is it Taurus or Gemini? On May 20th the answer depends on birth year and time, since the Sun is usually in the last degree of Taurus but can cross into Gemini. The blend is often described as grounded curiosity: Venus-ruled steadiness meeting Mercury's quick mind. Birthday number 2 adds diplomacy, making this a natural go-between, calm but conversational.

By noon UTC on May 20, the Sun has normally reached roughly 29° of Taurus. That places the date in the Taurus decan that astrologers give to Saturn, the third of three. The cusp of Taurus and Gemini, around May 20 and 21, is where a fixed earth sign hands over to a mutable air sign. The changeover happens at a particular minute, and that minute varies with the year, so your actual Sun sign depends on when and where you were born. Checking a calculated chart removes the guesswork. Those who feel both energies often describe a grounded mind that also loves variety: someone who enjoys conversation and new ideas but wants them to lead somewhere tangible, preferably with a good meal along the way.

sections.heading: Numerology of the May 20 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same May 20 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: May 20 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 20 is the 140th day of the year (141st in a leap year). In most years Gemini season is under way by May 21, 1 day after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 20 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. May 20 is also the birthday of Honoré de Balzac (1799), John Stuart Mill (1806) and Cher (1946).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 20?
faq.answer: May 20 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Taurus or Gemini on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Taurus. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 20 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 20?
faq.answer: By May 20 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 20?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a May 20 birthday are Honoré de Balzac (1799), John Stuart Mill (1806) and Cher (1946). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
